example.title: Residence of George W. Ball (historic halftone, c.1900)

brief: Two-storey Stick/Queen Anne frame house seen through huge elms on a deep lawn (old book halftone): a cross-gabled roof with a shingled front gable, louvered shutters on paired windows, a two-storey canted bay at one corner, and a broad front porch smothered in climbing vines with a low lattice rail. Curving walks across the lawn; a frame barn/carriage house behind. Colours assumed (photo is monochrome): dark red body, cream trim.
